title: 第6章 指纹鉴定
content_zh:
第6章 指纹鉴定
刑警队的院子，比平日里冷清了许多。
宁台县这种几十万人的县城，大案要案发生的概率并不多，一年到头，也就是十起八起的非正常死亡，最后会变成刑事案件的，也就是所谓的凶杀案的，大约就是一两起的样子。
正因为如此，哪怕今次的案件似乎案情简单，刑警队也是全员出动的模式。
江远回到办公室，就见刑科队所在的四楼已是空空如也，只有痕检办公室的门开着，有人在里面忙忙碌碌的敲键盘。
“报告写细致一点，这个案子搞不好要死刑的，死刑核检的要求很严的。”吴军提醒了江远一句，又道：“我们当年做一个案子，有件证物是只塑料油桶，案子办完都两年了，结果突然接到电话，问我们，为什么照片里的油桶是白色的，实际证物是黄色的。”
江远一边开机一边听，不由好奇道：“为什么？”
“为什么？因为实际证物放的久了，塑料老化了呗。还得重新做补充材料。”吴军停顿了一下，接着道：“说这个，就是想给你讲，死刑的核验比其他案件严格的多，好多双眼睛盯着呢，标准放高一点没坏处。”
“明白了。”江远从善如流，稍停，又问：“那我和十七叔的关系……要不要规避？”
“近亲属才需要。”吴军说的近亲属，在不同的法律条文中有不同的范围，其中行政法的范畴最广，刑法的最窄，仅为夫妻父母子女和同胞兄弟姐妹。
江远安心下来，认真做事。
很快，他的面前，就认真排列出了一列列的照片。
十七叔的肠子，十七叔的心脏，十七叔的脑切片，十七叔的胃容物……江远认真挑选，注释清楚。
对警察们来说，办案的繁复程度，往往远胜于破案。就像是眼前的命案，哪怕案情简单清晰，嫌疑人认罪，到了办案阶段，依旧有数不胜数的文书工作要进行。
快到下班时间，才有喧闹声从院子里传来。
江远看向窗外，就见刑警队的三辆车全都停了进来，二中队的刘队长更是身着警械，如临大敌的站到了中间的警车前。
十七婶身材瘦削，目光呆滞的戴着手铐，从后座挪了下来。
老实讲，江远对十七婶没什么好与不好的记忆。考公之前，他在外地读了五年的医科大，高考之前，他又在寄宿学校读了三年的高中，对十七婶的印象，远不及对十七叔的大肚皮的印象……
“嫌疑人指认了凶器，是一把厨师刀，被丢到了小区外面的垃圾桶里。”吴军也站起来看下面，顺便给江远更新了案情。
江远吁了一口气。案件进行到这个程度，破案工作基本就算是结束了，尤其是这种丢弃了凶器，又异处指认的，翻案难度比仅有口供的难了何止十倍。

“弃尸呢？她一个人搬不动吧。”江远又多问了一句。
“她弟弟帮忙搬的，用的是店里运菜的三轮车和推车。”吴军停顿了一下，又道：“人也抓了，交代了。”
如此一来，这就是物证口供皆全，基本已是铁案了。
胡思乱想间，半透明的系统界面，跳了出来。
任务：做一次全面的尸检，协助侦破案件
任务奖励：重庆式单指指纹分析法——弓型纹鉴定（LV3）。
江远瞪大眼睛看着，就见一只银色的团子，飞进了自己的脑门里。
纷繁的信息，狂躁的挤入。
重庆式单指指纹分析法，是单指指纹分析法的一种，也是国内最早采用的单指指纹分析法，专门用来应对，只有一个手指的指纹，甚至只有一个残缺的手指指纹的情况。与之类似的，还有国内的青岛式单指指纹分析法，国外的巴特利式单指指纹分类法等多种方法。不同的分析法也谈不上优劣之分，主要是对指纹的分类分型不同，分析方法略有不同。
简单来说，这就是一种用来比对指纹的技术。
江远眼神微亮，指纹比对可以说是痕检的看家本事了，而且，真正学习起来耗时耗力，系统直接赠送，顿时感觉幸福指数上升了。
不过，比对指纹也不是一件轻松的活计。
那种将随便一张什么指纹照片录入电脑，就嘎吱嘎吱的找出匹配指纹的机器，到目前为止都是不存在的。
国际上成熟的指纹自动识别技术（AFIS），甭管用的是RBNEC，还是美国COGENT，或者法国Morpho，采用的都是人工标注现场指纹特征，也就是所谓的特征点，然后在系统里，对指纹的特征点进行自动匹配检索，最后按照相似程度，从高到低的打分，以给出候选检视名单。
这是因为指纹会因为压力等因素出现变形，而且往往是非线性的变形，许多时候，指纹还会出现平移，覆盖的情况，保存条件不佳更是家常便饭，而在犯罪现场找到的指纹，更有可能是残缺不全的。
简而言之，指纹自动识别技术，需要有人先对指纹做人工预处理。
而像是员工打卡机之类的设备，它们只懂得比对两个指纹是否相同，且识别率完全达不到警方的需求。
吴军这时候只看江远神情不属，不由咳咳两声，道：“也没什么事了，你想下班，就先回去，剩下的我来搞。”
“呃……可以吗？”江远有些迟疑。他有点想试试新得的技术，不过，回家再试似乎也不妨碍。
“咱就这些活，做完就得了。”吴军傲然的抬起下巴，比起下面才开始忙起来的民警们，法医的忙碌已是结束了。

(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 6 Fingerprint Identification
The courtyard of the criminal police team was much deserted than usual.
In a county like Ningtai County with hundreds of thousands of people, there are not many major cases. Throughout the year, there are eight out of ten abnormal deaths, which will eventually turn into criminal cases, which are so-called homicides. There are only one or two cases.
Because of this, even if the case this time seems to be simple, the criminal police team is in full deployment mode.
When Jiang Yuan returned to the office, he saw that the fourth floor where the criminal investigation team was located was empty. Only the door of the trace inspection office was open, and someone was busy typing on the keyboard inside.
"Write the report more carefully. This case may lead to the death penalty, and the requirements for death penalty verification are very strict." Wu Jun reminded Jiang Yuan, and then said: "We were doing a case back then, and one of the exhibits was a plastic oil drum. It has been two years since the case was completed, but we suddenly received a call asking us why the oil drum in the photo was white and the actual evidence was yellow."
Jiang Yuan turned on the phone and listened, and couldn't help but asked curiously: "Why?"
"Why? Because the actual evidence has been stored for a long time and the plastic has aged. We have to make supplementary materials again." Wu Jun paused and then said: "I just want to tell you that the verification of death penalty is much stricter than that of other cases. There are many pairs of eyes staring at it. There is no harm in setting the standard higher."
"I understand." Jiang Yuan followed the good advice, paused, and then asked: "Then the relationship between me and Uncle Seventeen...should we avoid it?"
"Only close relatives are needed." The close relatives Wu Jun said have different scopes in different legal provisions. Among them, administrative law has the broadest scope, and criminal law has the narrowest scope, which only covers spouses, parents, children, and siblings.
Jiang Yuan calmed down and worked seriously.
Soon, rows of photos were carefully arranged in front of him.
Seventeenth Uncle's intestines, Seventeenth Uncle's heart, Seventeenth Uncle's brain slices, Seventeenth Uncle's stomach contents... Jiang Yuan carefully selected and annotated clearly.
For police officers, handling cases is often far more complicated than solving them. Just like the murder case in front of us, even if the case is simple and clear, and the suspect pleads guilty, there is still countless paperwork to be completed when the case is handled.
It was almost after get off work time when noisy noises came from the yard.
Jiang Yuan looked out the window and saw all three vehicles of the Criminal Police Team parked in. Captain Liu of the Second Squadron was wearing police equipment and stood in front of the police car in the middle as if facing a formidable enemy.
Aunt Seventeen, who was thin and handcuffed with dull eyes, moved out of the back seat.
To be honest, Jiang Yuan has neither good nor bad memories of Aunt Seventeen. Before taking the public examination, he went to a medical school in another place for five years. Before taking the college entrance examination, he attended high school in a boarding school for three years. His impression of Aunt Seventeen was far less than his impression of Uncle Seventeen's big belly...
"The suspect identified the murder weapon as a chef's knife, which was thrown into the trash can outside the community." Wu Jun also stood up and looked down, updating Jiang Yuan on the case.
Jiang Yuan breathed a sigh of relief. When the case progresses to this level, the work of solving the case is basically over. Especially if the murder weapon is discarded and identified in a different place, it is ten times more difficult to overturn the case than if it is only a confession.
"Where is the abandoned body? She can't move it alone." Jiang Yuan asked again.
"Her brother helped move the food, using the tricycles and carts used to transport vegetables in the store." Wu Jun paused, and then said: "The person was also arrested and accounted for."
In this way, the physical evidence and oral confessions are complete, and it is basically an ironclad case.
While thinking wildly, the translucent system interface jumped out.
Mission: Conduct a comprehensive autopsy to help solve the case
Mission reward: Chongqing-style single-finger fingerprint analysis method - bow pattern identification (LV3).
Jiang Yuan stared with wide eyes and saw a silver dumpling fly into his head.
Numerous information, crowded in manically.
Chongqing style single fingerFingerprint analysis is a kind of single-finger fingerprint analysis method. It is also the earliest single-finger fingerprint analysis method adopted in China. It is specially used to deal with the situation where there is only one finger fingerprint, or even only one incomplete finger fingerprint. Similarly, there are various methods such as the domestic Qingdao-style single-finger fingerprint analysis method and the foreign Bartley-style single-finger fingerprint classification method. Different analysis methods cannot be said to be superior or inferior. The main reason is that the classification of fingerprints is different and the analysis methods are slightly different.
Simply put, this is a technology used to compare fingerprints.
Jiang Yuan's eyes brightened slightly. Fingerprint comparison can be said to be the most important skill in trace inspection. Moreover, it is time-consuming and labor-intensive to actually learn it. The system directly gave it to him, and he immediately felt that his happiness index increased.
However, comparing fingerprints is not an easy task.
The kind of machine that can input any fingerprint photo into a computer and instantly find matching fingerprints does not exist so far.
The internationally mature automatic fingerprint identification technology (AFIS), regardless of whether it is RBNEC, American COGENT, or French Morpho, all uses manual marking of on-site fingerprint features, which are so-called feature points. Then, in the system, the feature points of the fingerprints are automatically matched and retrieved, and finally the fingerprints are scored from high to low according to the degree of similarity to give a list of candidates for inspection.
This is because fingerprints will deform due to factors such as pressure, and often in a non-linear manner. In many cases, fingerprints will also shift and cover. Poor storage conditions are commonplace, and fingerprints found at crime scenes are more likely to be incomplete.
In short, automatic fingerprint recognition technology requires someone to manually preprocess the fingerprints first.
As for devices such as employee punch-in machines, they only know whether two fingerprints are the same, and the recognition rate cannot meet the needs of the police.
At this time, Wu Jun just saw Jiang Yuan's expression and couldn't help but coughed twice and said: "There's nothing going on. If you want to get off work, just go back first and I'll do the rest."
"Uh...is that okay?" Jiang Yuan hesitated. He kind of wanted to try out his new skills, but it didn't seem to stop him from trying again at home.
"That's all we have to do, just finish it." Wu Jun raised his chin proudly. Compared to the policemen who were just starting to get busy below, the forensic doctor's work was already over.
(End of chapter)
